notes: Published aggregate statistics only. No faces, photos or per-person data were ingested. See docs/scoring/REFERENCE_DISTRIBUTIONS.md.

overall_score.publisher: The Face Report (Known by One, LLC)
overall_score.title: Face analysis study: 15,447 facial scans
overall_score.license: No licence stated for the harmony statistics; we reuse a handful of published aggregate facts with citation and copy none of the page's text, charts or data files.
overall_score.score_engine: The Face Report overall harmony score (0-100), engine as recalibrated June-July 2026

cohort.description: People who ran a front photo through the publisher's free analysers on one UTC day; repeat scans possible; skews young and male; no demographic split.
cohort.description_zh: 某一天主动使用该网站免费分析工具的扫描（自愿参与，可能有重复，偏年轻、偏男性），不是对人群的随机抽样

component_medians.note: Median scan per sub-score as shown on the publisher's sample report. Used only to compare our component medians during calibration (scripts/calibrate_score_scale.py); never to rank.

publisher_checks.note: 0.35*81 + 0.25*70 + 0.25*85 + 0.15*78 = 78.8, so the published weights reproduce the overall; our CDF places 79 at top 35%, one rounding step from the publisher's own claim.

ratio_norms.publisher: The Face Report (Known by One, LLC)
ratio_norms.title: Facial measurement norms: 14,144 frontal scans
ratio_norms.attribution: Facial measurement norms (14,144 frontal scans, 31 Aug 2026) by The Face Report, https://thefacereport.com/guides/facial-measurement-norms, CC BY 4.0. Values copied unchanged; landmark indices are our own reconstruction.
ratio_norms.landmark_model: 478-point browser face mesh (publisher does not name the model; MediaPipe Face Landmarker topology assumed)

cohort.description: People who ran a front photo through the publisher's free analysers on one UTC day; skews young; no demographic split; no published pose filter or outlier removal.
cohort.description_zh: 某一天主动上传正脸照的扫描（自愿参与，偏年轻），不是对人群的随机抽样

metrics.published_definition: Angle of the inner-to-outer eye-corner line against a fitted face-horizontal axis; positive = outer corner higher.
Inner-eye-corner distance divided by the average visible width of one eye.

metrics.name_zh: 面宽 / 上面部高（眼睑起算）
metrics.published_definition: Cheekbone width divided by visible upper-face height (upper-eyelid midpoint to upper lip).
Visible face-mesh height (mesh top to chin) divided by cheekbone width.
Distance between iris centres divided by cheekbone width.
Brow midpoint to nose base divided by visible face height.
Nose base to chin divided by visible face height.
Detected jaw width divided by cheekbone width.
Mouth-corner width divided by cheekbone width.
Alar (nostril) width divided by mouth width.
Nose bridge to tip divided by visible face height.
Outer-lip height (upper-lip top to lower-lip bottom) divided by mouth width.
